About_&_Key_Points:
About
Disa India Ltd is a leading equipment manufacturer with advanced foundry and surface preparation process technology.
It supplies complete foundry systems, with molding machines, sand mixers with combination of sand plant equipment, surface preparation machines and environmental control systems across the country.

Business Overview:
[1]
DISA India Limited, headquartered in Bengaluru, is engaged in providing integrated foundry solutions. The Company supplies complete foundry systems by combining DISA's moulding machines and sand mixers with sand plant equipment, Wheelabrator-based surface preparation machines and environmental control systems.
Its product portfolio includes a range of sand moulding equipment catering to the diverse requirements of the foundry industry.
IT is promoted by DISA Holding A/S, Denmark and DISA Holding AG, Switzerland, which collectively hold
